g.text: Turn raster artwork into SVG paths for websites, apps and design tools.
A fixed-resolution PNG is the only input.
✓ Local conversion ✓ Real SVG geometry ✓ No manual path editing
Actual plugin run · logo preset · simplify 1 · speckle filter 0 · self-created demonstration artwork
Tracing approximates the raster. It does not recover the original design file.
